message.content: For the past 15 years I have been smoking your 120 mm Menthol filter. (That is 2 pack a day) Now I don’t claim any reward if this can be called loyalty. You produce the good I like and I pay. No big deal. But don’t you have any kind of promotion or deal, like free Marlboro, wheel, quick exit, T-shirt, watches, jackets, etc. to make their customers happy? I believe you make as much sales as they do, or is it time to change brand?
